claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Fenoldopam is a peripherally restricted dopamine D1 receptor agonist that is unlikely to kill cancer cells at 2.5 uM; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, plausibly reflecting dopamine-receptor-mediated signaling or a physicochemical/off-target effect rather than a canonical cytotoxic mechanism.
